events.title: Forgery is moving to January 21, 2027
events.summary: First, thank you. Next Fest has been the biggest week Forgery has ever had. Over 1,500 of you played the demo, and your runs, feedback and wishlists kept my inbox busy all week.The feedback also gave me a clear list of things I want to get right before launch. I could ship on October 29 and fix them later, but Forgery only gets one launch, and I want it to be the good version. events.title: Demo update: your metal is no longer a rental
events.summary: It’s been a great Next Fest so far! We’re loving all the feedback in Forgery’s official Discord, and thank you to everyone who’s wishlisted the game. You’ve given us plenty to work on. Here’s the latest: Metals now stay equipped between rounds. Pay 4 coins to swap. Your first swap to a newly discovered metal is free, and switching back to Copper is always free. You bought the ingot. You get to keep it. Clearer die wording. Flat scoring bonuses now consistently say “value,” including conditional

events.title: Demo update: His Majesty has complaints
events.summary: Small demo update, large royal ego. The King is here to give you shit when you lose. He’ll comment on your dies, colours, and how things went wrong. You can retry without hearing him out. A quick look north. New runs start with a short map intro. Hold to skip. Less tooltip clutter. Hover for half a second to open one, then move between them instantly. Removed the retired Day’s Work button from the menu. Enough artificial intelligence at Next Fest. Have some hereditary incompetence.

events.title: Forgery at Steam Next Fest: Updated Demo, New Boss, More to Unlock
events.summary: Demo update: three collections, two difficulties, one very demanding boss The updated Forgery demo is live! Here’s what’s in it. Three collections to unlockStart with First Forgery. Beat Surface to unlock Living Ink, then clear Living Ink’s Surface run to unlock The Golden Touch. Each has its own pool of dies.All three collections include Surface and Underworld. events.title: Forgery’s demo has been rebuilt!
events.summary: Forgery’s demo has been rebuiltI’m trying very hard not to call this update “Reforged.”Over the past few months, we’ve taken Forgery apart and rebuilt it around a better question: what can you make happen in eight punches? Your die placement, cards, metals, and contract choices now work together in more surprising ways, with plenty of changes shaped by your feedback.The updated demo is free on Steam now.
